pictures.name: SH1-Bedside
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A spacious lamplit room in an ancient Egyptian house with painted columns and linen curtains. Jacob in old age, a very old man with a long white beard and a rust-red blanket, lying on a carved wooden bed, seen from behind his head or with his face turned away into shadow (face never visible). Around the bed stand and kneel his twelve grown sons, bearded men of different ages in robes of brown, indigo, ochre and olive, leaning in close, faces full of love and worry. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue shadows, quiet tenderness.
